values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

values.note: 25 sites 'suitable for tents and small trailers' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted), six of them walk-in/paddle-in sites in a field by the river meant for paddlers and North Country Trail hikers, so about 19 are drive-in. One camping unit and six people per site.

The intention is for these six sites to be used by river paddlers and through hikers'; 'There are six paddle- and/or hike-in sites'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (25 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground in a pine forest on the Manistee River, 7 mi N of Manton via US-131 and Old US-131. Group camping is available in the walk-in area by the river. On the North Country Trail and the 21-mile Fife Lake Loop to Spring Lake State Forest Campground; kayak landing and carry-in access in the campground. ORVs and snowmobiles may ride to nearby trails, with access only from the north. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20 (confirmed), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed, derived -> manual), 25 sites confirmed (six are walk-in/paddle-in, not five as the note said). Season 'open all year' (roads not plowed) already manual. Not equestrian; ORVs allowed between campground and trails (access from the north only) but not described as an ORV trail camp. Phone 231-775-7911 (Mitchell SP) matches. Access via US-131 and Old US-131, no road warning. Note: walk-in count corrected, field restatements trimmed.
